title: Shipping and delivery
text:
We deliver everywhere in Morocco.
Orders to Casablanca, Rabat and Marrakech arrive in 1 to 2 working days. Other cities take 2 to 4 working days.
Shipping costs 35 MAD per order and is free for orders over 500 MAD.
We also ship to France, Belgium and Spain in 5 to 8 working days for 120 MAD per order.
Orders placed before 2 pm are packed the same day. You get a tracking link by SMS and email as soon as the parcel leaves our warehouse.

title: Returns and refunds
text:
You can return any unused item within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in their original packaging.
Return shipping is free when the item is faulty or we sent the wrong item. Otherwise a 25 MAD return fee is deducted from your refund.
Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5 working days after we receive the item.
Cushion inserts and opened candles can't be returned for hygiene reasons.
To start a return, message us on WhatsApp with your order number.

title: Payment methods
text:
We accept Visa and Mastercard bank cards, PayPal for orders from outside Morocco, and cash on delivery in Morocco for orders up to 3,000 MAD.
Card payments are processed by CMI with 3-D Secure. We never store your card number.
Business customers can pay by bank transfer for orders over 5,000 MAD; we send a proforma invoice first.
Prices on the site include VAT (20%).

title: Contact us
text:
Customer service is open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm.
WhatsApp: +212 600 000 111. Email: help@atlas-home.example.
Showroom: 12 Rue Example, Maarif, Casablanca. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 10 am to 8 pm.
We answer WhatsApp messages within one hour during opening times.

title: About Atlas Home
text:
Atlas Home is a Moroccan home decor shop founded in 2019 in Casablanca.
We sell handmade Berber rugs, Safi ceramics, brass lamps and cotton throws made by about 40 artisans in Morocco.
Every rug comes with a card naming the cooperative that wove it.
